pages.title: Family stays | Coral Crown Hotel
blocks: Make room for everyone at
. Our family suites are designed for seaside breaks with children, luggage and the one toy nobody can sleep without.
An indoor swimming pool provides an alternative when the coast is doing its impression of a leaking ceiling.
Ask reception about room arrangements before booking. Writing “the quiet child” in the special requests box does not create one.
pages.snippet: Family suites and indoor swimming, with room for the favourite toy.

pages.title: Pool questions | Coral Crown
blocks: IS THE POOL INDOORS?
Yes. Our heated indoor pool is protected from the weather, though not from your uncle’s explanation of how he nearly became a competitive swimmer.
CAN CHILDREN USE IT?
Please check current swimming arrangements with reception. Children must be supervised; an inflatable crocodile does not count as a responsible adult.
ARE TOWELS A SOUVENIR?
No. Neither are the robes, the room key or the unusually reassuring receptionist.
pages.snippet: Indoor swimming, supervision and the disputed legal status of borrowed towels.

pages.title: Coral Crown Hotel | Stay with your dog
blocks: The
lists dogs as welcome. Check directly with the hotel about suitable rooms and any arrangements before booking.
Dogs welcome does not mean dogs welcome everywhere. Ask about dining areas and other shared facilities rather than letting your spaniel negotiate at the door.
Pack a lead, your dog’s usual food and something familiar to sleep on. If they prefer your expensive jumper, congratulations: they have already packed.
This is a dog-friendly accommodation listing. We do not maintain records of individual guests, human or otherwise.
pages.snippet: A dog-friendly seaside stay. Confirm room arrangements with the hotel.

pages.title: Coral Crown Hotel | Eastern promenade directory
blocks: The
advertises family suites, an indoor pool and private functions on the eastern promenade.
Its seahorse crest is part of the hotel’s branding. Seaside businesses are not obliged to choose different marine animals, however much easier that would make our directory.
The hotel’s functions page lists weddings, a Coastal Garden Society dinner and a junior sailing club awards ceremony. Consult the hotel’s own page for the published information.
Other coastal accommodation includes The Mariner and Hotel Miramar. Similar crests do not mean shared bookings, owners or guest lists.
pages.snippet: Family suites, indoor pool and private functions on the eastern promenade.

pages.title: Coral Crown — family break or competitive towel folding?
blocks: SUITCASE_TETRIS: “Looking at Coral Crown for a family break. Is the indoor pool worth packing three extra bags?”
JUST_ONE_MORE_BAG: “My children considered the pool the entire holiday. Apparently the sea was insufficiently rectangular.”
PAWS_AND_EFFECT: “We took our dog. Contact the hotel about room arrangements first. He approved of the bed, which is not the same as being allowed on it.”
FOLDING_PROFESSIONAL: “The towel animal in our room looked like a swan. By morning it looked like a tax dispute.”
MODERATOR: “Please keep reviews about your own stay. No photographs of other guests or children. The towel swan has declined an interview.”
pages.snippet: Indoor pools, dogs and a towel swan with unresolved personal issues.
